title: The Careful note in the margin
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：careful　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 careful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the researcher wrote of ① a careful note in the margin in the paper, and everybody in the lab said at once that it was ② more careful than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the researcher, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the careful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most careful note in the margin anybody in the lab had ever seen, or so the paper for February 1964 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too careful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the careful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a careful plan for the winter, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as careful as the plan for the winter they had once had in the old lab. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was careful or not, and he said so.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was ⑦ something careful, and nothing besides. The student from the next lab called the whole plan ⑧ quite careful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the paper kept the names of the careful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980, twice over, she wrote of another careful note in the margin in the same paper, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ more careful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most careful plan for the winter in the whole lab, she said in 1982, was the one she could never quite name; the careful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 仔细（前置定语 a careful note in the margin：1970 年研究员在研究报告里记下的那件仔细的批注）
B. adj. 仔细／谨慎（比较级 more careful than：文中两处，一处比页边的批注，一处比预想）
C. adj. 仔细／谨慎（最高级 the most careful：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 仔细（表语 too careful to do：母亲觉得它太仔细，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 谨慎（前置定语 a careful plan for the winter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩谨慎的打算）
F. adj. 谨慎（同级比较 as careful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩过冬的打算相比）
G. adj. 谨慎（后置定语 something careful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 谨慎（受程度副词修饰 quite careful：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a careful note in the margin
the most careful note in the margin anybody
a careful plan for the winter
The most careful plan for the winter in

answers.why: careful 意为“仔细”，1970 年研究员在研究报告里记下的是“一件仔细的批注”，此处作前置定语 a careful note in the margin。
careful 意为“仔细”，此处用比较级 more careful than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
careful 意为“仔细”，研究报告上 二月 那行字说它是实验室里最仔细的一件，故用最高级 the most careful note in the margin。
careful 意为“仔细”，母亲认为这件东西“太仔细了，谁也用不上”，too careful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
careful 意为“谨慎”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩谨慎的打算”，此处作前置定语 a careful plan for the winter。
careful 意为“谨慎”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩过冬的打算一样谨慎”，同级比较用 as careful as。
careful 意为“谨慎”，研究报告上那半行字要的是“谨慎的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something careful。
careful 意为“谨慎”，邻实验室来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当谨慎”，quite 修饰原级 careful。
careful 意为“谨慎”，1980 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要谨慎”，故用比较级 more careful than。
careful 意为“谨慎”，母亲 1982 年说的是“整个实验室里最谨慎的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most careful plan for the winter。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，研究员在研究报告里记下了一件仔细的批注。（a careful note in the margin）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更仔细。（more careful than …）
母亲觉得它太仔细，谁也用不上。（too careful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩谨慎的打算。（a careful plan for the winter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩过冬的打算一样谨慎。（as careful as …）
到了 1977 年，研究报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件谨慎的东西。（something careful）
answers: In 1970 the researcher wrote of a careful note in the margin in the paper.
Everybody said it was more careful than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too careful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a careful plan for the winter.
He said nobody would call it as careful as the plan for the winter they had once had.
By 1977 the paper asked for nothing but something careful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 careful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the researcher wrote of a careful note in the margin in the paper, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most careful note in the margin in the lab, or so the paper says.
My mother thought it too careful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a careful plan for the winter, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next lab called the plan quite careful, and everybody laughed.
The careful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
